question: In which state is the Nandi Award for the best choreographer presented every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Nandi Awards are prestigious awards presented annually by the government of **Andhra Pradesh** to recognize excellence in Telugu cinema, theatre, and television.
 
• The award was instituted in **1964** and is considered one of the highest honors in the Telugu film industry.
 
• The Nandi Awards are named after the **Nandi (bull),** a cultural and historical symbol of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The Best Choreographer Award is among the many categories that honor exceptional contributions to Telugu cinema, including acting, directing, and technical excellence.
 
• The awards are typically announced by the Department of Information and Public Relations of the Andhra Pradesh government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Choreography:**

 
 
• Choreography refers to the art of designing sequences of movements, typically in dance, which are performed by artists in films, theatre, or other performances.
 
• Choreographers play a vital role in enhancing the visual appeal of songs and dance sequences in cinema.
 
 
 
• **Telugu Film Industry:**
 
 
• Also known as "Tollywood," it is one of the largest regional film industries in India, producing films in the Telugu language.
 
• It has a significant audience base in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and among the Telugu-speaking diaspora worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Other Nandi Award Categories:**
 
 
• Best Actor, Best Actress, Best Director, Best Screenplay, and Best Music Director, among others.
 
• Special awards like the Raghupathi Venkaiah Award are given for lifetime contributions to Telugu cinema.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Nandi Symbol:**
 
 
• The bull, Nandi, is associated with Lord Shiva and represents strength, loyalty, and cultural heritage in Hindu traditions.
 
• The award trophy features a depiction of Nandi as a mark of cultural pride for Andhra Pradesh.
